description: Thresholds for the Xerberus portfolio what-if gate

max_post_token_share_pct.description: Maximum share of the book (percent) the largest post-trade position may hold. Only denies when the change also grows that position's share. The design reference uses 50.

max_hhi_delta.description: Maximum tolerated increase in the token Herfindahl-Hirschman index (0-1 scale). The design reference uses 0.01.

min_ladder_30d_delta_pp.description: Minimum tolerated change, in percentage points, of the share of the book exitable within 30 days. Negative values allow some deterioration; the design reference uses -3.

max_slowest_exit_delta_days.description: Maximum tolerated increase in the portfolio's slowest token exit, in days. The design reference uses 3.

deny_on_issues.description: When true, deny if Xerberus reports any simulation issue (for example unpriced tokens or changes it could not apply).

deny_on_stale.description: When true, deny whenever Xerberus flags its data window as stale (is_stale).

max_data_age_seconds.description: Maximum tolerated age of the Xerberus data window, measured at evaluation time.

require_intent_party_in_wallets.description: When true, deny unless the intent's sender or target is one of the simulated wallets, so a simulation of one portfolio cannot authorise a transaction on another.

allow_stale_when_risk_reducing.description: When true, a pure removal (no additions) is not denied for stale or old data, so an agent can always reduce exposure. The delta checks still apply.
